STEP 1 - Scene: A side salad-style plate: mixed baby greens (spinach, chard/beet-type leaves) with a bean/grain salad topped with red pepper pieces, plus a portion of cauliflower (florets and some mashed/riced cauliflower) and a dark roasted vegetable piece (possibly beet or purple vegetable).

- Mixed leafy greens (spinach, chard): large share of plate

- Grain salad: 50 g x 120 kcal/100g = 60 kcal

Total ≈ 123 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A partly covered (~64%) side-salad plate with a modest grain salad and cauliflower portion at ~280 g and ~120 kcal is plausible. Nothing visible suggests added oil or dressing in large amounts, so no extra fat was added.
